name: Mukluks of Comfort
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 7th; Slot feet; Price 500 gp; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

Made from sealskin, these leather boots repel water, retain warmth, and constantly circulate fresh air to grant the wearer immunity to immersion foot syndrome. Despite the preceding effects, they offer no benefits in cold environments, no resistance to cold, and no immunity to cold.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells control water; Cost 250 gp.
